chapters.title: Define target audiences with dynamic groups
Sender identity: shared mailbox and permissions

takeaways: Use Exchange dynamic distribution groups built on directory attributes for self-maintaining audiences and static distribution lists only for curated groups.
Send every edition from a shared mailbox with a reusable Outlook template, and run submissions and approvals through Microsoft Forms, Planner and Power Automate.
Measure delivery with message trace and delivery reports, visualize KPIs in Power BI, and govern the newsletter with clear roles, retention and version control.
hook: Internal updates posted in Teams often vanish in chat noise. This episode is for communications, HR and IT teams who want a reliable internal newsletter without new software. It shows how to build one with Outlook, Exchange dynamic groups, a shared mailbox, templates, Power Automate and Power BI.
